exposes_tools.name: market.quote
exposes_tools.description: Current price of one asset, in the currency that asset's market quotes in. Callers name the asset AND its venue; which source answers a venue, at which URL, is chosen by this plugin. CRYPTO prices in USDT, US in USD, HK in HKD, CN in CNY — nothing is converted between them.

asset.description: Asset name. Bare (`BTC`) means the crypto venue; a venue-qualified name is `<VENUE>:<SYMBOL>` over CRYPTO, US, HK and CN (`CRYPTO:BTC`, `US:NVDA`, `HK:1810`, `CN:600519`). A prefix counts only with the colon, so `USNVDA` is a crypto name.

exposes_tools.name: market.holdings.set
exposes_tools.description: Record how much of an asset this Track holds. Replaces any existing quantity for that asset; 0 removes it. Records only — the price is fetched by the plugin's own refresh, which this call wakes. Each venue is priced in its own currency, and a Track whose priced holdings span two currencies gets per-asset rows but no total and no history points until currency conversion lands.

asset.description: Asset name. Bare (`BTC`) means the crypto venue; a venue-qualified name is `<VENUE>:<SYMBOL>` over CRYPTO, US, HK and CN (`CRYPTO:BTC`, `US:NVDA`, `HK:1810`, `CN:600519`). A prefix counts only with the colon, so `USNVDA` is a crypto name.

quantity.description: How much is held. 0 removes the holding.

exposes_tools.name: market.holdings.list
exposes_tools.description: What this Track currently holds, with the venue, latest price, value and currency of each. A total is stated only when the priced holdings are all in one currency.

quote.description: The settlement currency a portfolio's total is meant to be stated in. It is not a pricing input: each market is quoted in its own currency and nothing is converted yet, so this key has no effect on the published numbers until currency conversion lands.

binance_endpoint.description: Base URL of the Binance market-data source. api.binance.com is geo-restricted from some hosts; data-api.binance.vision serves the same /api/v3 paths with no key.

sina_endpoint.description: Base URL of the Sina quote list, the US, HK and CN source. Its /list= path is asked for gb_<symbol>, hk<code>, sh<code> and sz<code>.
